subject: BrightRetail MAP: dataset exchange playbook and usage constraints
messages:
From: Alice Cohen <alice.cohen@brightretail.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BrightRetail — request: evaluation dataset & prompt pack

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We loved the latency profile on the Dedicated config — looks promising for our search augmentation POC.

To move towards the MAP and help Procurement/Legal move quickly, can you send over: 1) a small evaluation dataset (anonymized product Q&A samples and user paraphrases, ~10k rows), 2) your recommended prompt pack / test cases so we can validate quality regression, and 3) the usage constraints/licensing language you require for MAP evaluation only.

Our close target for this stage is end of month (Nov 30) so we can include results in the Q4 vendor shortlist. Can you confirm:
- What format you prefer for the dataset (CSV/Parquet)?
- Any access controls you expect (S3 pre-signed, IP allowlist)?
- Whether you need a signed data-use addendum or a short MSLA amendment to restrict use to evaluation?

Looping in procurement (procurement@brightretail.com). If you can get the handoff wrapped up this week, we can schedule the evaluation run next Monday.

Best,
Alice
Alice Cohen
Head of Data Science — BrightRetail
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Cohen <alice.cohen@brightretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightRetail — request: evaluation dataset & prompt pack

Hi Alice — great to hear and glad the demo was useful.

Quick answers up front: CSV or Parquet are both fine (CSV will be easiest for quick consumption). We typically hand over a) a trimmed evaluation sample plus b) a prompt/testcase pack (zipped) and then c) a short evaluation-only usage addendum that gets appended to the MSLA. Access is normally via a short-lived S3 pre-signed URL + explicit NDA/addendum signature for evaluation-only rights.

Marissa — can you confirm the standard eval addendum language we should use for BrightRetail? Ben — can you stage a 10k anonymized sample and the prompt-pack (include acceptance criteria and scoring rubric) and prepare a pre-signed link that expires in 7 days?

Our proposed MAP milestones: 1) Handoff dataset + prompt pack (this week), 2) BrightRetail runs eval and submits results (by Nov 27), 3) joint review and quick remediation if needed (Nov 29), 4) decision/shortlist (Nov 30). If any of those dates need to shift we can adjust.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Cohen <alice.cohen@brightretail.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightRetail — request: evaluation dataset & prompt pack

Sean / Ben — legal has a short eval addendum template we use. Key points:
- Evaluation-only license (no production deployment)
- Data may only be used to run the evaluation and derive non-identifying metrics
- No model training/fine-tuning on BrightRetail data without explicit written consent
- Link expiry of handed-off assets (we recommend 7 days)
- Watermarking / metadata tagging requirement for any outputs retained beyond evaluation window

I've attached the redwood-eval-usage-checklist.pdf with language we typically include. For the dataset itself, Ben: anonymize PII, keep original distribution of query lengths, and include a small gold set (200 hand-checked rows) so BrightRetail can compute precision@k and hallucination rates. For the prompt pack, include negative test cases (edge prompts) and an acceptance threshold.

If Alice/procurement are OK with the addendum, we can send a DocuSign and the S3 link after signature.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Alice Cohen <alice.cohen@brightretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightretail.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightRetail — request: evaluation dataset & prompt pack

Thanks Marissa — that addendum sounds reasonable. Procurement: we will sign the eval addendum if Redwood marks the data "evaluation-only" and adds the watermarking requirement. We also need the S3 handoff to be limited to a BrightRetail allowlist and a 7-day expiry.

We can sign the DocuSign this afternoon. Can you confirm the exact expiry timestamp and whether Redwood will require BR to destroy local copies of outputs (we may need a short retention window for debugging logs)?

Thanks,
Alice
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Cohen <alice.cohen@brightretail.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightRetail — request: evaluation dataset & prompt pack

Hi all — handing off assets per the MAP. Links and stubs below.

Attachments (stubs):
- brightretail_eval_samples_v1.csv (CSV, 12MB) — 10,000 anonymized rows + 200 gold rows included.
- prompt-pack-v3.tar.gz (TAR.GZ, 4.2MB) — includes scoring rubric and negative testcases.

S3 pre-signed links (access controlled):
- Dataset: https://s3.redwood-example.com/presigned/brightretail_eval_samples_v1.csv?expires=2026-11-25T14:08:00Z
- Prompt pack: https://s3.redwood-example.com/presigned/prompt-pack-v3.tar.gz?expires=2026-11-25T14:08:00Z

Usage constraints (summary):
- Evaluation-only (no production deployment or training).
- Link expiry: 2026-11-25T14:08:00Z (7 days).
- Allowlist: access limited to BrightRetail IP ranges and the two emails on this thread.
- Outputs: BrightRetail may retain non-identifying aggregate metrics and screenshots for reporting; any retained model outputs containing original tokens must be redacted. Temporary debug logs allowed up to 30 days then must be destroyed.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rdw/SA-EX-2026-0427 (eval addendum).

If procurement signs today we'll flip the bucket-level allowlist and confirm the expiry time in the DocuSign payload.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Alice Cohen <alice.cohen@brightretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightretail.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightRetail — request: evaluation dataset & prompt pack

Got the links and checked the prompt pack — thank you, Ben. Proc has signed the DocuSign eval addendum (link included below). Two quick asks before we start the run Monday:

1) Can Redwood allow a short, internal retention exception for developer debug logs (we need 48 hours beyond the run to reproduce a flaky case)? Your note mentioned 30 days — we can accept redaction and stricter controls but 48 hours would be sufficient for our team.
2) Can you confirm the watermarking approach you expect on retained outputs (we prefer a metadata header + subtle token prefix so we can match back to the handed-off dataset during triage).

If those two points are OK we are set to run the evaluation on Nov 22 and will share results by Nov 27 per the MAP.

DocuSign confirmation: https://docusign.com/rdw/rdw-confirmation/BRIGHT-2026-EX

Best,
Alice
